name: firesync
description: FireSync - NASA-Inspired 3D Wildfire Intelligence & Satellite Observation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview"
